Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report, including the Board of Commissioners' supervision report and financial statements, while granting a full discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a total cash dividend of Rp 90 per share, consisting of Rp 70 from 2025 net profit and Rp 20 from 2024 retained earnings, with Rp 200 million allocated to reserve funds.
Agenda #3: Shareholders approved the appointment of PKF Hadiwinata to audit the financial statements for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026.
Agenda #4: Authority was granted to the majority shareholder, TECABLE (HK) CO. LIMITED, to determine the 2026 remuneration, including salaries and bonuses, for the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #5: Shareholders approved pledging more than 50% of the company's net assets as collateral for loan facilities obtained from banks or other financial institutions.
